_spec: The film of scenes — « option 3 », chosen by the owner on 2026-10-14 after the benchmark; it replaces the single 21-s flow of storyboard.json (docs/design/pro-app-preview.md, version 1). Cut from the takes recorded on 2026-10-14 (README.md « Version 2 — the takes of 2026-10-14 »), revised after two reviews the same day (« … after review »). Nothing here is final until the owner signs it off. Takes are relative to --takes (build/app-store/pro/preview/v2/takes): one folder a take, its take.mov and the gestures.json reformatted from the recorder's gestures.jsonl. README.md « Version 2 — scenes » says what every value does.
_never_shown: sign-in; « Mon abonnement » or an offer; KYC (« Vérification »); a « Compte de démonstration — … » message; a system alert; a legible phone number; the « Prestations » price list as a scene. Checked by eye on the frames and by OCR of every decoded frame; the tool reads none of it.

S6.what: « Aperçu de ma page »: the salon's public page from its cover photo, a short scroll — « Votre page MyWeli, / prête pour vos clients. », budget 4 s; take5/take.mov, scroll-page, lead_in_s 1.0, rest_after_s 0.8
S6.why: Out of this cut until it has a take this storyboard allows. take5 was filmed on a build without CARTO_BASEMAPS_KEY: its map is CARTO's « API KEY REQUIRED » tile in every picture, which a store build cannot show (mobile/lib/core/config/app_config.dart; tool/release_build.sh refuses to build without the key). take5b, on a keyed build, scrolls 290 pt: through the « Contact » block and onto the salon's phone, where this scene asks for a short scroll that never reaches « Contact ». At rest on its cover the page already shows the « Contact » title and the top of the map (y 566–740 pt), so no take of this page from its cover avoids the block's title. To bring S6 back: a short scroll filmed on a keyed build — or the owner rules that the rule is about the phone, and take5b is cut with the phone masked.

end_card.title: MyWeli Pro
end_card.line: Un compte MyWeli Pro est nécessaire.
